samples.title: Self introduction and background
samples.goal: User introduces background and connects it to the role.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Good morning. Thanks for joining today. Could you start by briefly introducing yourself?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sure. I have three years of experience in backend development, mainly building APIs and data services.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Great. Which project from that experience is most relevant to this role?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I worked on a payment monitoring system that reduced incident response time by about thirty percent.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: That sounds relevant. What was your specific responsibility on that project?

target_expressions: I have three years of experience in...

samples.title: Behavioral question
samples.goal: User answers a challenge question with a specific example.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Tell me about a time when you had to handle a difficult deadline.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: In my last project, our release date moved forward by one week, so I helped the team split the work into must-have and nice-to-have tasks.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: How did you communicate that change to stakeholders?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I sent a short status update every day and explained the trade-offs clearly.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: What was the final result?

samples.title: Candidate question
samples.goal: User asks a thoughtful question about the team.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Before we wrap up, do you have any questions for me?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes. Could you tell me more about how this team measures success in the first three months?

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Good question. We focus on onboarding speed, ownership, and collaboration with design and data teams.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That makes sense. What would be the most urgent problem for this role to solve?

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: The most urgent problem is improving reliability for our core user workflow.

target_expressions: Could you tell me more about...

samples.title: Basic order
samples.goal: User asks for a recommendation and places an order politely.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Hi, welcome in. Are you ready to order, or would you like a few more minutes?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I am ready. What would you recommend today?

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: The grilled chicken sandwich is popular, and the tomato soup is also very good.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Could I have the grilled chicken sandwich and a glass of water, please?

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Of course. Would you like fries or salad with that?

samples.title: Dietary request
samples.goal: User asks about ingredients and makes a special request.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Do you have any questions about the menu?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes. Does the chicken salad contain nuts?

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: It has almonds, but we can remove them if you prefer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Could you make it without almonds, please? I have a nut allergy.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Absolutely. I will make a note for the kitchen.

samples.title: Wrong item received
samples.goal: User handles a service issue politely.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: How is everything so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The food looks good, but I think I received rice instead of pasta.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: I am sorry about that. Let me check your order.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: No problem. Could you please bring the pasta when it is ready?

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Yes, I will fix that right away.

samples.title: Weekly progress update
samples.goal: User gives completed work, current work, and next step.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Let's start with your update. What did you finish last week, and what are you focusing on next?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I finished the API changes last week and shared the test results with the team.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Good. What are you working on this week?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I am currently working on the dashboard integration, and I expect to finish the first version by Thursday.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Please send the timeline after the meeting.

samples.title: Blocker and risk
samples.goal: User explains a blocker and asks for priority clarification.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Are there any blockers we should discuss?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The main blocker is that we do not have the final design for the settings page yet.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: How does that affect the schedule?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: If we do not get it by tomorrow, the frontend work may be delayed by two days.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Understood. I will follow up with design today.

samples.title: Clarifying requirements
samples.goal: User asks for clarification and confirms next action.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: We need to update the onboarding flow for enterprise users.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Could you walk me through the new requirement? I want to make sure I understand the priority.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Sure. The highest priority is reducing the number of manual approval steps.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Got it. I will draft a simpler flow and share it by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: That works. Please include the open questions in the draft.

samples.title: Changing deadline
samples.goal: User proposes a deadline change and explains why.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Do you still think we can finish the analytics update by Wednesday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We may need to move the deadline to Friday because the data export is taking longer than expected.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: What would be ready by Wednesday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The UI changes will be ready, but the final metrics need two more days of validation.

turns.speaker: ai
turns.text: Okay. Please send a revised plan this afternoon.
